session_end_persistence_policy.completion_definition: A batch is not completed until a GitHub commit SHA exists.
session_end_persistence_policy.rule: Persist every completed batch to GitHub before ending a session, then update CHECKPOINT.json and HANDOFF.md with the exact next resume point.

cp_status.note: CP reconstruction is finished. Do not resume CP translation unless a new source version requires an update.

dll_status.batch_policy: Translate/recover in approximately 100-key batches, QA token skeleton and Han characters, and commit each completed batch immediately.

remaining_release_blockers: Merge CP and DLL localization into the installation-ready Vietnamese package.
Build and verify the final release archive containing localization files only.

resume_target.priority_1: Continue DLL from index 1 using the exact extracted 3.13.4 source.
resume_target.priority_2: Persist every DLL batch immediately after QA.
resume_target.priority_3: After DLL 2419, run final CP/DLL QA and build the release package.
